title: German Pilaf with Dates and Zesty Flavor
description: A flavorful and savory pilaf dish from Germany, infused with the sweetness of dates and a zesty twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped dates and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the pilaf and zesty flavor to the saucepan.
Pour in the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and cover the saucepan.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the pilaf is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork before serving.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
